reader_summary.headline: Our Summer Series kickoff is with one of the all-time greats, Annie Duke .
reader_summary.overview: Our Summer Series kickoff is with one of the all-time greats, Annie Duke . The former world-class poker player has become a noted academic and practitioner in the art of decision-making. Her best-seller Thinking in Bets is a one-of-a-kind set of tools and tips to try (emphasis on try) to get past our embedded behavioral biases.

key_points.text: And her follow-up works How to Decide and Quit pull different threads in the decision-making process.
Since writing Thinking in Bets, Annie has consulted several investment organizations to apply her insights to investing.
